dex.entry: A more developed ice-sprite that has gathered enough ambient ice to give itself a more defined, humanoid shape. It still bounces on rounded feet, but now manifests ice structures around itself — walls, bridges, steps — apparently decorating its territory. The structures always collapse after a day.

art.silhouette: Slightly taller, more defined sprite form; a distinct head on a short neck, arms with three-fingered ice hands; face is more expressive and detailed; occasionally surrounded by small floating ice-crystal fragments it is sculpting; mid-ground presence at 40px.
art.palette: Slightly taller, more defined sprite form; a distinct head on a short neck, arms with three-fingered ice hands; face is more expressive and detailed; occasionally surrounded by small floating ice-crystal fragments it is sculpting; mid-ground presence at 40px.
art.direction: The ice-sculpting-territory-decoration behaviour makes it feel like a small, weird artist — immediately lovable.
